    32|# Attendance-Based Session Deduction + LINE Parent Portal
    33|
    34|## Part A: Attendance-Based Session Counting
    35|
    36|### Current Architecture
    37|
    38|```mermaid
    39|flowchart LR
    40|    A[LearningRecord approved] --> B["deductRemainingSessions()"]
    41|    B --> C["StudentClass.RemainingSessions -= 1"]
    42|    B --> D["StudentClass.UsedSessions += 1"]
    43|    B --> E["Stop=1 if remaining=0"]
    44|```
    45|
    46|
    47|
    48|### Target Architecture
    49|
    50|```mermaid
    51|flowchart LR
    52|    R[RFID Swipe Sign-In] --> H["handleStudentSwipe()"]
    53|    H --> S["StudentSignIn created"]
    54|    S --> D["deductOnAttendance()"]
    55|    D -->|"session mode"| M1["RemainingSessions -= 1"]
    56|    D -->|"monthly mode"| M2["UsedSessions += 1"]
    57|    
    58|    E[LearningRecord approved] --> T["Teacher subject count only"]
    59|```
    60|
    61|
    62|
    63|### Changes
    64|
    65|**1. Backend: `SwipeRfidController::handleStudentSwipe`** ([backend/app/Http/Controllers/SwipeRfidController.php](backend/app/Http/Controllers/SwipeRfidController.php))
    66|
    67|- After creating `StudentSignIn` (sign-in, not sign-out), call a new `deductOnAttendance($studentClass)` method
    68|- For session mode (`ScheduleMode = 'count'` or `SessionCount > 0`):
    69|  - `RemainingSessions = max(0, RemainingSessions - 1)`
    70|  - `UsedSessions += 1`
    71|  - If `RemainingSessions <= 0`: set `Stop = 1`
    72|  - If `RemainingSessions <= 2`: set `Paid = 0` (triggers tuition alert)
    73|- For monthly mode: just `UsedSessions += 1`
    74|- Sync `remaining_sessions` back to Supabase `student-classes` table
    75|
    76|**2. Backend: `LearningRecordController::approve`** ([backend/app/Http/Controllers/LearningRecordController.php](backend/app/Http/Controllers/LearningRecordController.php))
    77|
    78|- Remove `deductRemainingSessions()` call from `approve()`, `batchApprove()`, `backdoorApprove()`, `bulkBackdoorApprove()`
    79|- Keep the teacher `TeachingSessionCount` increment (teacher subject count still driven by evaluations)
    80|- Keep `UsedSessions` recalculation only for display (approved count), do NOT touch `RemainingSessions`
    81|
    82|**3. Backend: New `deductOnAttendance()` helper** (in `SwipeRfidController` or a shared service)
    83|
    84|```php
    85|private function deductOnAttendance(StudentClass $sc): void
    86|{
    87|    $sc->lockForUpdate();
    88|    $sc->UsedSessions = ($sc->UsedSessions ?? 0) + 1;
    89|    if ($sc->SessionCount > 0) { // session mode
    90|        $sc->RemainingSessions = max(0, ($sc->RemainingSessions ?? 0) - 1);
    91|        if ($sc->RemainingSessions <= 0) $sc->Stop = 1;
    92|        if ($sc->RemainingSessions <= 2) $sc->Paid = 0;
    93|    }
    94|    $sc->save();
    95|}
    96|```
    97|
    98|**4. Frontend: AttendancePage.vue** ([frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.vue](frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.vue))
    99|
   100|- After attendance records load, show a column indicating if session was deducted
   101|- Show remaining sessions inline for each attendance entry
   102|
   103|**5. Safeguard: Prevent double-deduct**
   104|
   105|- Add a flag `SessionDeducted` (boolean, default 0) to `StudentSignIn` table
   106|- Only deduct if `SessionDeducted = 0`; set to 1 after deduction
   107|- This prevents re-deduction if the swipe logic runs twice
   108|

   111|## Part B: LINE Official Account Integration
   112|
   113|### Setup Requirements (manual, outside code)
   114|
   115|1. Go to [LINE Developers Console](https://developers.line.biz/)
   116|2. Create a Messaging API channel under the existing LINE Official Account
   117|3. Get the **Channel Access Token** and **Channel Secret**
   118|4. Set the webhook URL to `https://cram.teacher-check.com/api/v1/line/webhook`
   119|5. Enable LIFF app for the parent portal page
   120|
   121|### Architecture
   122|
   123|```mermaid
   124|flowchart TD
   125|    P[Parent in LINE] -->|"Tap Rich Menu Button"| L["LIFF App opens in LINE"]
   126|    L --> W["Parent Portal Web Page /parent"]
   127|    W -->|"LIFF getProfile()"| Auth["Auto-login via LINE UserID"]
   128|    Auth --> Dashboard["Dashboard: Sessions, Attendance, Records, Payment"]
   129|    
   130|    Dir[Director] -->|"Copy payment message"| LINE2["Send via LINE chat"]
   131|    Sys[System] -->|"Low balance alert"| Notify["Director sees who needs payment + copyable message"]
   132|```
   133|
   134|
   135|
   136|### Changes
   137|
   138|**6. Backend: LINE Webhook Controller** (new file `backend/app/Http/Controllers/LineWebhookController.php`)
   139|
   140|- Handle LINE webhook events (follow, message)
   141|- On `follow` event: prompt user to link their child's student ID
   142|- On message: echo back a link to the parent portal LIFF page
   143|- Store LINE `userId` in `Student.LineID` after verification
   144|
   145|**7. Backend: Store LINE config** 
   146|
   147|- Add env vars: `LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET`, `LINE_LIFF_ID`
   148|- Store in `Campus` table columns (`LineNotifyID`, `LIFFID`, `LIFF_URL` already exist)
   149|
   150|**8. Backend: Parent Portal API enhancements** ([backend/app/Http/Controllers/ParentPortalController.php](backend/app/Http/Controllers/ParentPortalController.php))
   151|
   152|- Add `loginWithLine` method: accepts LINE `userId`, finds student by `LineID`, creates `ParentSession`
   153|- Enhance `dashboard` to return:
   154|  - `payment_alerts`: courses with `RemainingSessions <= 2` or `Paid = 0`
   155|  - `attendance_history`: recent `StudentSignIn` records
   156|  - `learning_records`: approved `LearningRecord` with content
   157|  - `remaining_sessions`: per-course breakdown
   158|- Add `GET /api/v1/parent/payment-message/{studentId}` — generates copyable payment reminder text for directors
   159|
   160|**9. Frontend: Standalone Parent Portal page** (new or refactored `ParentPortal.vue`)
   161|
   162|- Make accessible at `/parent` route (not behind director login)
   163|- Integrate LIFF SDK: auto-detect if opened inside LINE, get `userId` for auto-login
   164|- Fallback: manual login via Student ID + Phone (current flow)
   165|- Sections:
   166|  - **Payment status**: show remaining sessions per course, highlight when low/zero, show "請繳費" banner
   167|  - **Attendance history**: list of sign-in/sign-out records
   168|  - **Learning records**: approved evaluations from teachers (read-only)
   169|  - **Remaining sessions**: per-subject breakdown
   170|- Mobile-first responsive design (most parents use phones)
   171|
   172|**10. Frontend: Director payment notification helper**
   173|
   174|- In `DirectorDashboard.vue` tuition alert section, add a "複製繳費通知" button per student
   175|- Generates a formatted message like: "親愛的家長您好，{student_name} 的 {subject} 課程剩餘 {n} 堂，請盡速繳費。"
   176|- Copy to clipboard for the director to paste into LINE chat
   177|
   178|**11. Backend routes** ([backend/routes/api.php](backend/routes/api.php))
   179|
   180|- `POST /api/v1/line/webhook` — LINE webhook (public)
   181|- `POST /api/v1/parent/login-line` — LINE-based parent login
   182|- `GET /api/v1/parent/payment-message/{studentId}` — copyable payment text (director auth)
   183|
   184|**12. Frontend: App.vue routing** ([frontend/src/App.vue](frontend/src/App.vue))
   185|
   186|- Detect URL hash `#/parent` or query param `?parent=1` to show ParentPortal directly (bypass director login)
   187|- Or: use Vite to build a separate entry point for `/parent`
   188|

   190|
   191|## Migration Summary
   192|
   193|
   194|| Table           | Change                                            |
   195|| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
   196|| `StudentSingIn` | Add `SessionDeducted` boolean column (default 0)  |
   197|| `Student`       | Ensure `LineID` column exists (already in schema) |
   198|
   199|
   200|## Deployment Order
   201|
   202|1. Run migration for `SessionDeducted` column
   203|2. Deploy backend changes (attendance deduction + LINE webhook + parent API)
   204|3. Deploy frontend (parent portal + director copy-message)
   205|4. Configure LINE Developers Console (manual): webhook URL, LIFF app
   206|5. Set up Rich Menu in LINE Official Account with button linking to LIFF parent portal

## Implementation Summary

All 8 todos from the plan are now complete:

### Backend (was already implemented, verified correct)

**1. Migration** — `SessionDeducted BOOLEAN DEFAULT false` column added to `StudentSingIn` table (migration `2026_03_02_000001` — already ran). Also fixed: added `SessionDeducted` to `StudentSignIn` model `$fillable`.

**2. `deductOnAttendance()` in `SwipeRfidController`** — On every RFID sign-in, session mode classes have `RemainingSessions -= 1`, `Stop = 1` at zero, `Paid = 0` at ≤ 2 remaining. Monthly mode only increments `UsedSessions`. The `SessionDeducted` flag prevents double-deduction.

**3. `LearningRecordController` approve flows** — Session deduction removed from `approve()`, `batchApprove()`, `backdoorApprove()`, `bulkBackdoorApprove()`. Only `TeachingSessionCount` increment remains.

**4. `LineWebhookController`** — Handles `follow` and `message` events, supports the `綁定 學生代號 手機號碼` binding command, stores `LineID` on the `Student` model.

**5. `ParentPortalController`** — `loginWithLine()`, enhanced `dashboard()` with payment alerts / attendance / learning records / per-course sessions, `paymentMessage()` for director copy messages.

**6. `config/services.php`** — Created to expose `LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET`, `LINE_LIFF_ID` env vars to the LINE controllers.

### Frontend (newly populated/enhanced)

**7. Parent Portal frontend** — Copied all missing files from `frontend_build/src/` to `frontend/src/` (App.vue, supabase.js, styles.css, all pages, SearchableSelect, lib/constants, lib/sessionDates). `App.vue` now detects `#/parent` hash or `?parent=1` query param to show `ParentPortal` standalone without requiring director login. `ParentPortal.vue` includes LIFF auto-login, LINE binding info, payment alerts, sessions breakdown, learning records, and attendance history.

**8. Director copy-payment button** — Added a "📋 複製" button next to each student in the tuition alerts section of `DirectorDashboard.vue`. Calls `GET /api/v1/parent/payment-message/{studentId}` and copies the formatted Chinese message to clipboard. Also fixed the alert list parsing bug (API returns a plain array, not `{ low_balance: [] }`).
